verdict.rationale: Weave is an observability platform, not an agent, so this axis applies. W&B documents an official MCP server that gives coding assistants and chat agents direct access to runs, traces, evaluations and artifacts, with a public GitHub repo. A REST Service API with an OpenAPI spec provides programmatic access to Weave data, and W&B Skills cover the Weave SDK. Marketing says Claude Code can read live production data and run evaluations through these. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence that the MCP server or API exposes metrics such as cost/token data or signals, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging.
